description: This file defines a React component for a user profile form that allows changing email and password details, utilizing Formik for form management and Yup for validation.

classes.name: InnerForm
classes.description: A React functional component that renders the form fields for email and password, and displays validation errors and status messages.

methods.name: mapPropsToValues
methods.description: Maps outer component props to initial form values, setting email from userEmail and password as empty.

methods.name: validationSchema
methods.description: Defines validation rules for email and password fields using Yup.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, calls changeUserDetails, and updates status messages based on success or failure.
